tools.description: Search Cairn memory for past decisions, rules, gotchas and procedures. Returns cards {id,kind,title,summary,score}; more:n counts cut results; status:stale marks a doubted memory; label says why (replaced by, voted wrong, file deleted). kind=handoff returns the last session handoff. Fetch full records with memory_get.
tools.name: memory_search

tools.description: Fetch records by id. Detail is off by default. Set detail=true for one id only if the summary and reason are insufficient.
tools.name: memory_get

tools.description: Save verified, reusable knowledge. Per note: title <=10 words (80 chars max); summary one sentence, <=30 words (240 chars max). Move extra context to reason or detail. reason: why true or chosen (required except note), <=1,000 chars. Put longer background in detail. fields by kind: decision {context, alternatives[], consequences}; rule {exceptions}; gotcha {symptom, cause, fix}; procedure {steps[], when}; fact {source}; preference {example}. supersedes=<id> replaces your memory or a memory scoped to the same project. contradicts=<id> for a conflict you cannot replace. Default scope: project in initialized repos, personal otherwise or for preference/note. No secrets, logs or guesses. items: up to 3 notes in one call. aliases: up to 5 short questions this answers.
tools.name: memory_save

tools.description: Mark a memory helpful or wrong. Wrong from two people, or from its owner, makes it stale.
tools.name: memory_feedback

tools.description: Erase a memory you own. To replace outdated knowledge, save with supersedes instead.
tools.name: memory_forget
